# truenas_iscsi_portal (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `iscsi.portal` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the portal.
- `listen` (Attributes List) Array of IP addresses for the portal to listen on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listen))
- `tag` (Number) Numeric tag used to associate this portal with iSCSI targets.

<a id="nestedatt--listen"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listen`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address for the iSCSI portal to listen on.
- `port` (Number) TCP port number for the iSCSI portal.
